mostWorthwhile.text: Making the lettuce wick was the most worthwhile action: it showed how absorbent fabric can move solution to roots without another pump.

leastWorthwhile.text: Sowing the already-ready soybean row was straightforward progress, but offered less discovery than preparing the other beds.

surprise.text: The foil could not be fitted directly to the beds; it first needed a cloth backing to make a tear-resistant, lightproof sheet.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The foil-and-cloth prerequisite was initially unclear, but the result explained its purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical details of shading tubers and passively watering lettuce made me curious how the growing room develops.
